en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a rainy street scene with German troops marching in formation through a city. A military band leads the procession, followed by soldiers on foot, mounted troops on horseback, and early motor vehicles. Large crowds with umbrellas line both sides of the street, watching the parade. Leafless trees and multi‑story stone buildings frame the street. German caption text is printed at the top.
